name: Residual connection of phase CTs
summary: A residual CT connection combines secondary currents from phase CTs to obtain a residual-current input.
description: A residual CT connection combines secondary currents from phase CTs to obtain a residual-current input. This is a connection arrangement that should be drawn explicitly rather than assigned an unsupported separate standard-symbol number.
readingNotes: Match secondary polarity and CT characteristics across the connected phases.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Residual connection of three phase CTs is not the same physical sensor as a core-balance CT.
